name: Voxel2Mesh
aliases: 3D Mesh Model Generation from Volumetric Data
definition: A CNN-based architecture that generates 3D surface meshes directly from 3D image volumes without post-processing, avoiding artifacts and enabling end-to-end training.
summary: Voxel2Mesh is a CNN architecture that generates 3D surface meshes directly from volumetric data without post-processing, outputting explicit vertices and faces rather than voxel grids.
